markdown_frontmatter.skills/airwallex-split-card/SKILL.md:
name: airwallex-split-card
description: Generate Airwallex Split Card Element integration code. Use when user mentions Split Card, cardNumber element, expiry/cvc element, individual card inputs, custom card form, 拆分卡元素, or 自定义卡输入. Do NOT use for Drop-in (multi-method) or HPP (redirect) flows.
allowed-tools: Read Grep Bash Write Edit WebFetch
argument-hint: "[scenario: guest | save-card | save-only | saved-card | mit | styling | full]"
markdown_frontmatter.skills/airwallex-ai-provider-card-mit/SK:
name: airwallex-ai-provider-card-mit
description: Use this skill to guide an end-to-end implementation plan document for card-only Airwallex Payments flows used by AI providers that self-manage subscriptions, token balances, manual top-ups, and auto-recharge with merchant-initiated transactions. Covers Web JS SDK Split Card Elements, card binding, billing information collection, fraud-data checks, scheduled MIT consent for subscriptions, unscheduled MIT consent for recharge, webhooks, and merchant-owned ledger, invoice, receipt, retry, notification, and cancellation logic. Do not use for non-card methods, customer-initiated one-click checkout, hosted checkout, Drop-in, HPP, or provider-managed subscription products.
allowed-tools: Read Grep Bash Write Edit WebFetch
argument-hint: "[scenario: plan | recharge | auto-recharge | subscription | saved-card | renewal | full]"
name: airwallex-billing-checkout
description: Guide integration of Airwallex Billing Hosted Checkout for subscription, one-off payment (PAYMENT), and card-saving (SETUP) scenarios. Covers authentication, product/price creation, free trial, coupons, success page, webhooks, troubleshooting, and API version via .env. Use when user mentions billing checkout, subscription integration, recurring billing, free trial, coupon, promo code, billing_checkouts API, hosted billing page, 订阅, 周期扣款, 优惠券. Do NOT use for HPP / Hosted Payment Page / PaymentIntent; those belong to Online Payments, not Billing.
allowed-tools: Read Grep Bash Write Edit WebFetch
markdown_frontmatter.skills/airwallex-hpp/SKILL.md:

allowed-tools: Read Grep Bash Write Edit WebFetch
argument-hint: "[scenario: guest | save-card | save-only | saved-card | mit | styling | full]"
markdown_frontmatter.skills/airwallex-kyc/SKILL.md:

Use when user mentions KYC, embedded KYC element, createElement('kyc'), hosted KYC flow, connected account onboarding, 开户认证, 连接账户.
